seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Open seat: incumbent Lt. Gov. Eleni Kounalakis is term-limited and is on the November ballot for Treasurer. Both designations come from search summaries of the SoS certified list (8/27/2026), and the summaries say the PDF text extraction was jumbled. The primary certified list showed the same designations. One summary placed Gloria Romero's name near State Treasurer/CPA text, which appears to be an extraction artifact. Conflicts: Fiona Ma's BOE start year (2014 per Ballotpedia, 2015 per Wikipedia). Her bachelor's degree is described as a B.A. in one campaign release and a B.S. on SmartVoter, and a 2023 NUHW profile says she has degrees from UC Berkeley, which official sources do not state. Romero's Majority Leader years differ between sources. All Romero sources are secondary; no official or campaign bio was found before the search budget ran out. No birth data was recorded because no primary source surfaced.
